name: Kentucky State University
academic_ranking: Public historically black land-grant university (HBCU) founded in 1886; total enrollment approximately 2,020 (fall 2024). Offers 4 associate degrees, 55 undergraduate degrees, and 6 postgraduate programs across five colleges plus the Whitney Young School of Honors and Liberal Studies. No specific national numeric ranking confirmed from a primary source during research.
financial_aid: Federal and state aid, need-based aid, and institutional/athletic scholarships available as a public land-grant HBCU. Specific annual figures not confirmed from a primary source during research (2026-07); KSU tuition/cost-of-attendance pages returned HTTP 404 and third-party databases returned data for the wrong institution.
facilities_notes: Softball program listed on the KSU Thorobreds athletics site. No specific softball venue/stadium details were published on the softball program or facilities pages at time of research (2026-07).
program_reputation: NCAA Division II softball program competing in the Southern Intercollegiate Athletic Conference (SIAC) as the Kentucky State Thorobreds. Small 2026 roster (13 players). Team X/Twitter: @kysusoftball.
notes: Researched live 2026-07-30 from ksuthorobreds.com. Softball coaches page lists a two-person staff (head coach + one assistant). Tuition and scholarship_count set to null because they could not be verified from a reliable primary source (university tuition pages 404'd; NCES College Navigator / College Scorecard ID 157401 returned Murray State data). Roster size (13 players; excludes team manager) from the 2026 softball roster page.
